subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers refresh/adopt https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544 for this Control UI resolver fix, or request a fresh current-main replacement?
rationale: The source-level issue remains valid, but an open linked PR already owns the implementation path and appears to need maintainer handling rather than a duplicate automated fix job.

options.title: Refresh the linked PR
options.body: Adopt or update the linked PR against the current `ui/src/pages/channels/view.ts` path, then require focused UI proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Request a fresh replacement
options.body: If the fork PR cannot be updated cleanly, ask for a new narrow same-repository PR that ports the same resolver/test idea to current main.

options.title: Reject the behavior
options.body: Close the linked implementation path only if maintainers decide custom-only snapshots should intentionally hide unconfigured built-in discovery cards.

recommendation.title: Refresh the linked PR
recommendation.body: Adopt or update the linked PR against the current `ui/src/pages/channels/view.ts` path, then require focused UI proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is closest to the channel UI metadata/refactor path and the current UI file layout.
